card.title: Quality Director
card.description:
We are a fast-paced business with ambitious growth plans; so if you are dedicated, enthusiastic and always seeking ways to improve, you'll enjoy a career with us!

Director of Quality

**Weston - Florida, USA | Permanent | Full-time**

 

**About Ontic Weston**
----------------------

Weston is Ontic's newest site and an important part of the next stage of our growth in the US.

Acquired in 2026, the 130,000 sq ft facility will become a dedicated Original Equipment production site, complementing our MRO Center of Excellence in nearby Miramar. Together, our two South Florida locations give Ontic the space and capability to continue expanding as customer demand grows.

Joining Weston at this stage means more than joining a new facility. You'll have the opportunity to help build it - shaping teams, ways of working and culture as we prepare the site for operations in 2027. If you're energised by growth, change and the chance to create something from the ground up, this is a rare opportunity to do exactly that.

 

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Lead Quality for an aerospace manufacturing operation where reliability and customer confidence are fundamental. At Weston, you'll shape the way quality is built into products and processes while supporting a growing site's operational priorities.

You'll lead Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection activities, working with operations and external stakeholders to strengthen compliance, resolve complex issues and drive lasting improvements in product and process quality.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Lead and develop Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams, setting clear expectations and priorities.

* Develop, install and then maintain effective quality management systems and applicable aerospace certification requirements.

* Represent Quality with customers and government quality representatives, resolving issues constructively.

* Oversee quality planning, contract reviews, audits, material review activity and corrective actions.

* Partner across functions on new products, product integration and transitions into production.

* Use quality measures and root-cause analysis to reduce defects, scrap, warranty costs and repeat issues.

* Build a culture of prevention, accountability and continuous improvement.

 

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* At least 10 years of aerospace Quality experience in an AS9100 manufacturing environment, including significant leadership responsibility.

* A bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant discipline, plus knowledge of AS9100 internal auditing.

* Experience leading Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams in high-mix aerospace manufacturing.

* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, Federal Aviation Administration and Department of Defense requirements, and applicable contract clauses.

* Experience with audits, customer approvals, contract reviews, material review and corrective action.

* Strong structured problem-solving and executive stakeholder communication skills.

* Lean or Six Sigma experience and FAA designated manufacturing inspection representative training or certification would be advantageous.

 

**Why Ontic?**
--------------

At Ontic, we're specialists in keeping critical aircraft flying. Our work supports civil and military aviation around the world, giving established aircraft products the long-term support they need to remain safe, reliable and available.

But it's our people who make that possible. We're a growing, global team where you're trusted to take ownership, encouraged to challenge how things have always been done and supported to develop your career as our business grows.

We believe in embracing the challenge - working together to solve complex problems and create opportunities for our customers, our business and each other.

 

**Benefits at Ontic**
---------------------

At Ontic, we're committed to supporting our people to thrive - at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development and financial security, while giving everyone the opportunity to share in our success.

* Goal Share bonus program - everyone at Ontic is automatically enrolled, giving us all the opportunity to share in our success

* Paid volunteering time - giving you time to support a cause or community that matters to you

* 24/7 wellbeing support - confidential support available through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

* Employee discounts - access to discounts and offers across a range of retailers and services

* Learning and development - opportunities to build your skills, develop your career and grow with Ontic

* Employee referral program - rewarding you for introducing great people to Team Ontic

* Comprehensive medical insurance

* Competitive PTO, holiday pay and sick leave

* 401(k) plan - with up to 4% company match

* 9/80 work schedule - where applicable

 

**Ready to embrace the challenge?**
-----------------------------------

If this sounds like the kind of opportunity where you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and see where a career with Team Ontic could take you.

**Compensation Pay Range**

*Ontic Engineering and Manufacturing Inc. is an Equal* *Opportunity* *employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran* 
*Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

*This position must meet export control compliance requirements. To meet export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person ” as defined by 22. C.F.R. §120.15 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee.*

card.title: Director, EDS Strategy and Operations
card.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The Director, EDS Strategy and Operations is responsible for being a partner to the Enterprise Data Services (EDS) leadership team, connecting strategy to execution. They will translate EDS direction into a prioritized portfolio, running the operating rhythm that drives accountability and delivery, managing budget and risk, and representing EDS with business and technology partners across CareSource's Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, D-SNP, and Marketplace lines of business.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**

* Collaborate with the EDS senior leaders to translate data strategy into annual and multi-year plans, objectives and key results and KPIs aligned with CareSource enterprise goals.
* Lead strategic special projects and enterprise initiatives on behalf of the senior leader, including operating model enhancements and process improvement.
* Serve as thought partner and advisor to the senior leader with responsibility to frame decisions, pressure-test options, anticipate issues, and act as a delegate in meetings and forums when needed.
* Establish and run the EDS operating rhythm (leadership meetings, portfolio reviews, stage gates, quarterly business reviews, planning cycles) that drives accountability and ensures initiatives meet their goals and deadlines.
* Oversee EDS program execution in coordination with project managers, product owners, and engineering teams, ensuring Agile delivery practices and alignment with strategic priorities.
* Lead identification and management of Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (RAIDs), including data quality, privacy, and security risks, and drive resolution or escalation.
* Develop and report function performance analytics (delivery health, cost, adoption, service levels, and value realization) through executive dashboards and scorecards.
* Partner with Finance and EDS leaders on budget planning, forecasting, and management for capital and operational expenses, cloud consumption and platform costs, and resource planning.
* Support vendor and partner strategy, including sourcing evaluations, contract negotiations, procurement, and ongoing performance reviews for data platforms, tools, and professional services.
* Prepare executive communications, briefings, and presentations for senior leadership, the Board, and enterprise governance forums on EDS Enterprise Data Solutions strategy, progress, and outcomes.
* Perform any other job related duties as requested.

 
**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, analytics, or a related field required
* Equivalent years of relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of required education
* Ten (10) years of progressive experience in data analytics / technology, strategy, operations, consulting, or program and portfolio management required, including five (5) years of leading large-scale programs or portfolios required
* Five (5) years of leadership experience is required
* Experience in a chief-of-staff, strategy, or business operations role supporting senior technology or data leadership preferred

**Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:**

* Knowledge of enterprise data architecture (data platforms, pipelines, lakehouse, data modeling, analytics) and cloud platforms
* Working knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and data privacy, including HIPAA considerations
* Executive presence and excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Strong service orientation and consulting skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with all levels of management
* Ability to juggle multiple complex priorities within a changing environment
* Strong leadership and management skills
* Knowledge of the managed care industry is preferred
* Exceptionally self-motivated and directed
* Ability to motivate in a team-oriented, collaborative environment

**Licensure and Certification:**

* None

**Working Conditions:**

* General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time
* Travel is not typically required

**Compensation Range:**

$135,600.00 - $237,400.00

CareSource takes into consideration a combination of a candidate’s education, training, and experience as well as the position’s scope and complexity, the discretion and latitude required for the role, and other external and internal data when establishing a salary level. In addition to base compensation, you may qualify for a bonus tied to company and individual performance. We are highly invested in every employee’s total well-being and offer a substantial and comprehensive total rewards package.

**Compensation Type (hourly/salary):**

Salary

**Organization Level Competencies**

* Fostering a Collaborative Workplace Culture
* Cultivate Partnerships
* Develop Self and Others
* Drive Execution
* Influence Others
* Pursue Personal Excellence
* Understand the Business

 

**This job description is not all inclusive. CareSource reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. CareSource is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to fostering an environment of belonging that welcomes and supports individuals of all backgrounds.**

card.title: Director, Protein Operations
card.description:
Twist Bioscience is seeking a Director, Protein Operations to lead high-throughput protein production and characterization within our Operations organization. You will run a high-throughput operation that runs seven days a week and lead a large, multi-level team that delivers purified, well-characterized antibodies and proteins to internal programs and external customers on time, at quality, and at cost. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in protein expression, purification, and characterization with the rigor to scale a production organization and the drive to automate it.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

**Leadership and Operations**

* Lead a large protein production and characterization organization that operates seven days a week, including managers, supervisors, scientists, and associates.
* Own key performance indicators (KPIs) for quality, on-time delivery, turnaround time (TAT), capacity, and cost of goods sold (COGS), and model capacity and staffing against demand.
* Drive continuous process improvement and lead complex investigations, including customer incidents.
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, and training in line with ISO 13485 and other regulatory requirements.

**Protein Production**

* Oversee high-throughput antibody production in HEK293, CHO, and cell-free systems across IgG, Fab, scFv, VHH, and bispecific formats.
* Lead downstream purification of diverse biologics, including bispecific and engineered antibodies.
* Transfer new products and processes from R&D into production and support new product introductions (NPI).

**Protein and Antibody Characterization**

* Oversee Twist's binding, developability, and cell-based functional assay suite, from assay development through execution, analysis, and data reporting, with turnaround times as fast as 1–5 business days.
* Lead binding assessment, including flow cytometry on native antigen, single-point and full kinetics/affinity (KD) by SPR and BLI, and epitope binning by SPR and BLI.
* Lead developability profiling, including analytical size-exclusion chromatography (aSEC), thermostability (nanoDSF), size distribution (DLS), polyspecificity (BVP ELISA, ovalbumin off-target), self-interaction (AC-SINS), and hydrophobic interaction screening.
* Deliver high-quality, consistent datasets that support customer lead selection and AI/ML model training.

**Automation and Scale**

* Partner with Engineering to bring a high level of automation to production and characterization, translating workflows into requirements for liquid handling, robotics, scheduling, and data systems.
* Drive walk-away, high-throughput workflows integrated with LIMS, MES, and SAP to increase capacity, reduce turnaround time, and improve reproducibility.

**Collaboration**

* Partner with R&D, Process Development, Supply Chain, QC, QA, Project Management, and Customer Support to grow the portfolio and meet customer commitments.
* Shape technology and product direction with senior leadership while staying current on antibody discovery, protein expression, and lab automation.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* PhD in protein biochemistry, biological chemistry, immunology, or a related field with 8+ years of experience in biotech, biopharma, or life science tools; or a BS/MS with 12+ years of equivalent experience.
* Experience managing managers and leading large teams, with strong coaching and people development skills.
* A proven track record of scaling protein or antibody production workflows and commercial products.
* Hands-on expertise in mammalian expression, purification (e.g., ÄKTA), and antibody characterization, including SPR/BLI kinetics and epitope binning, flow cytometry, and developability assays (aSEC, nanoDSF, DLS, AC-SINS, polyspecificity).
* Success partnering with engineering teams to implement automated, high-throughput lab workflows.
* Experience owning budgets, KPIs, and capacity planning, with working knowledge of ISO 13485/GMP, Lean, and Six Sigma.
* A strategic thinker who executes tactically, prioritizes well, and influences senior leadership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience running a high-throughput, made-to-order production operation in the life sciences.
* Experience manufacturing and purifying engineered antibodies.
* Experience with antibody characterization platforms such as Carterra and Octet.
* Familiarity with LIMS, MES, and ERP/SAP systems.

**About Twist Bioscience**

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as "writing" DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care,agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

Twist Bioscience Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Twist Bioscience Corporation provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic characteristics, or any other category protected by law.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Ask yourself:**

* On a scale of 1 to 10, is your work ethic a 10+?
* Do you have true GRIT, tenacity, and live in the realm where anything is possible?
* Do you solve problems creatively and yet with regard to high quality and details?
* Do you relate to people well and think on your feet?
* Do you agree with the following statement: "If it is to be, it's up to me" - if you don't agree with this quote, we are not a match.

**The above is who we are looking for! We need a LEADER who GETS THINGS DONE WITH EXCELLENCE and has a strong desire to help make a successful small business better.**

The Director of Operations (DOO) is a key Protector for the growing expansion of the business. This manager is the master of systems, consistently seeking new, innovative, and efficient business processes that save time and money. As a key leader in this company, the Director of Operations (DOO) increases the ability of the Hub to process transactions, freeing the Sales Team to focus more on generating transactions than closing them.

This person relishes the opportunity to build, implement, and manage multiple systems, and is seen throughout the organization as the expert on efficiency and systems. card.title: Director, Practice Operations Framingham and Norfolk
card.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the West region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Framingham, as well as Norfolk, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

This role plays a critical part in shaping the Tufts Medicine ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery and expansion of exceptional care within the community.

Location: Hybrid and at sites within the designated region (e.g., Framingham & Norfolk)

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. Responsibilities typically include: ownership of short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Department, problems faced are often complex and require extensive investigation and analysis, and requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate and influence executive leadership.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

**Pay Range****:**

 
$134,525.66 - $171,524.44

*based on full-time equivalent*

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Job Overview**

The Director of Operations leads business operations and operations management, turning strategic plans into clear priorities and effective execution. You’ll guide executive-level teams, manage budgets and financial performance, and strengthen processes across the organization. This role calls for confident leadership, sound judgment, and a practical, data-driven approach to change and growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead operational excellence initiatives, process improvement, and operational analysis to improve business performance.
* Direct strategic planning, project management, and program management, aligning work with organizational priorities.
* Oversee executive-level budget management, financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and profit and loss analysis.
* Manage business development and business development management, identifying opportunities and coordinating execution.
* Lead change management, including large-scale organizational change, and communicate plans and progress clearly to executives. Your impact: Clear priorities and disciplined execution help teams deliver reliable operations and better serve customers.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, strategic management, and operational management.
* Experience in senior leadership, executive leadership, executive-level team management, management, and supervising experience.
* Strong budget management, financial management, forecasting, and profit and loss analysis skills.
